mapper.select: SELECT a.nature_cust_id, b.nature_cust_name FROM cust_t_nature_customer_developer a INNER JOIN zqzt_travel_nature_cust b ON a.nature_cust_id = b.nature_cust_id WHERE (b.nature_cust_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.nature_cust_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND a.oa_code = #{oaAccount} LIMIT 50
